lead.headline: Thinking Machines' Inkling 2 Mini: a looped 26B model that runs on your laptop
lead.summary: Inkling 2 Mini runs its middle layers three times for every token, so it can reason more without writing everything down. It's a mixture-of-experts model with 26.4B total and 3.4B active parameters, and Thinking Machines says it leads every open-weights model under 100B on DeepSWE v1.1 (48.2%) and Vals Index v2.2 (46.5%). A research variant with a variable loop count ships alongside it, and the lab reports that its chain of thought got shorter with more loops but stayed readable.

news.headline: Anthropic drops 8.5% on its first full day as chip stocks get hammered
news.summary: After Thursday's record debut, ANT closed Friday 8.5% lower. Nvidia and AMD both fell more than 13%, and Amazon, Google and Microsoft closed lower too. CNBC points to worries about the AI trade after Jensen Huang's ouster at Nvidia, sour public sentiment around data centers, and rising interest rates.

news.headline: The European Commission confirms an AI-assisted cyberattack took down some of its services
news.summary: The attack was detected on 22 October and hit systems including the Sysper HR platform, the MyPMO medical-reimbursement system and translation tools. The Commission says it found no evidence of a staff data breach. It hasn't named the AI tool, but the disclosure came about two weeks after CERT-EU warned that attackers were using the open AI pentesting framework Artex.

news.headline: Slush investors: AI makes software easy to copy, so money moves to hardware
news.summary: At Slush, investors said incumbents can now copy a software product in about four weeks, down from a year, so defensibility is moving to robotics, physical AI and deep tech. PitchBook data puts 2026 robotics and drone deal value at $68.8B, more than double 2025, with space-tech investment tripling.
